_note: The words of the cards that need a short explanation (see scripts/gameplay/keywords.gd). In the Response phase the panel beside the card shows its text with these words in color; pointing at one shows its text. words: what is matched in a card text (not case sensitive). A new effect on a later day is one entry here. role: the color role (GameColors) the player may change in Settings; the word then takes that color instead of color.

damage.name: Damage
damage.text: Lowers the threat's HP. When it reaches 0, the threat is contained.

block.name: Block
block.text: Soaks up damage from hits. It is gone when the enemy's turn is over.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.text: Each Dodge cancels one hit of the enemy's turn, so that hit does no damage. Unused Dodge is gone when the turn is over.

heal.name: Heal
heal.text: Gives HP back to you. You can never go above your maximum.

draw.name: Draw
draw.text: Takes cards from your deck into your hand right away.

energy.name: Energy
energy.text: You spend Energy to play cards. It is full again at the start of every turn.

exposed.name: Exposed
exposed.text: The threat takes more damage from every card you play after this one, until the end of your turn.

charge.name: Charge
charge.text: You get this much Energy at the start of your next turn.

leak.name: Leak
leak.text: Lose this much HP at the start of your next turn. Block cannot stop it.

cap.name: Cap
cap.text: Each hit of the enemy's turn does at most this much damage.

reflect.name: Reflect
reflect.text: Each time you are hit during the enemy's turn, the threat takes this much damage.

exploit.name: Exploit
exploit.text: If the threat is Exposed when you play this card, it deals this much more damage.
